goal: Researcher-defined experiments with JSON as authored source; 3D is an editing/observation interface, not the product endpoint.
execution_lifecycle: explicit plan and frozen execution inputs
P2_requirements: Within validated model capability rules users can author coordinates/settings in JSON; no required fixture IDs
Different valid user-authored configurations must produce corresponding inputs and records
Unsupported physics/units/combination errors are explicit; no substitute experiment
P4_requirements: Visual editing reads/writes the same definition and round-trips through JSON
No visual edit mutates existing revision/run/results
Steps/condition changes/repetitions/observables use declared state-transfer contracts
freedom_boundary: Support grows by declared models, not a fixed experiment catalogue. CP2K adapter does not execute arbitrary uploaded code or automatically support every equation. New user-defined physical modules follow validated extension contracts.
